_comment: Registry of source channels behind each video group. 'source_type' = how the group's video list is defined: 'channel_scrape' (yt-dlp scrape, cached under channel_cache/), 'curated' (hand-picked subset of a channel, hardcoded in transcribe.py VIDEO_GROUPS), or 'fixed' (standalone video/webinar, no parent channel). 'status' fields were last verified on 'last_checked'; regenerate with the check-new-videos flow.
